ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central fluke body with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the distal tips, approximately 7:3 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black contiguous region. Distal tips exhibit high-contrast white patches with irregular, feathered boundaries. Left tip white region contains a localized tan-to-yellow hue shift.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with a wide angle and moderate depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Heterogeneous serration pattern with significant jagged valleys on the right lobe and more consistent small-scale peak variations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-density clusters of small circular white pixel groups on both the left and right distal tips, indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint white linear pixel disruptions visible on the right black lobe surface and right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations along the trailing edge, particularly a distinct notch on the inner right lobe margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized tan/ochre discoloration on the white surface of the left distal tip.
